kindLine.constraint: A hard boundary: require or forbid
kindLine.fact: A checkable claim about the world

header.inForce: {kindLine}. It is in force because {commit} merged, and it stops being in force the same way.
header.inForceNoCommit: {kindLine}. It is in force because the commit that published it merged, and it stops being in force the same way.

editor.counts: {lines, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} · {characters} chars
editor.note: This is the statement and nothing else. The lineage, the force, the scope and the effect are the rest of the file, and each one is changed the same way: a pull request against {repository}.
editor.noteNoRepository: This is the statement and nothing else. The lineage, the force, the scope and the effect are the rest of the file, and each one is changed the same way: a pull request against the main repo.

propose.title: Propose a change to this record
propose.lead: A published record is changed the way it was published: a branch, a pull request, the same six checks, and a merge. Nothing here edits what is in force.
propose.pendingOpen: Branch {branch} is waiting on its checks. Land or close that one first, so two changes are never proposed over the same file.
propose.readOnly: Your role can read this record and not change it. An org Owner or Admin, or a workspace Owner or Member, can propose a change.

lineage.name: Lineage
lineage.what: {lineage} keeps its lineage. An amended record is the same record, not a new one

hash.name: record_hash recomputation
hash.what: recomputed over the new bytes · the old hash stays on every run that carried it

conflict.name: Conflict against active records
conflict.what: re-run in full, because the words changed

propose.done: {repository}#{number} opened. {lineage} changes when it merges; until then every run still gets the words that are in force now.
propose.doneNoPr: The proposal is raised. {lineage} changes when its pull request merges; until then every run still gets the words that are in force now.

status.proposed: The proposal is raised and its pull request has not opened yet.
status.pr_open: The pull request is open. Its checks have not run yet.
status.checks_passed: All six checks passed. The pull request is ready to merge.
status.checks_failed: At least one check failed. Read the pull request for which one.

archive.title: Archive {lineage}?
archive.body: Archiving is a pull request that sets status = "archived" on {path}. The file stays, the lineage stays, and the record stops compiling into the bundle when it merges. It is in force until then.
archive.gate: This record carries {effect}. Any gate compiled from it goes with it, and what it refused today is allowed once this merges.
archive.kept: Nothing is deleted. Every run this record steered keeps naming its hash, and a later record may supersede it instead.
archive.notRecorded: Oxagen cannot open this pull request yet: no capability writes an archived status to a record file. Until one does, open it by hand on {repository}.
archive.notRecordedNoRepo: Oxagen cannot open this pull request yet: no capability writes an archived status to a record file. Until one does, open it by hand on the main repo.
archive.archivedBody: It is out of force and kept. Every run it steered still names its hash.
archive.pendingTitle: {lineage} already has a pull request open
archive.pendingBody: Branch {branch} is waiting on its checks. Land or close that one first, so two changes are never proposed over the same file.

lineage.title: Lineage
lineage.badge: the graph remembers everything; git decides what is in force
lineage.publishedNotRecorded: not recorded. Oxagen read the record but could not reach its commit history.
lineage.effectNotRecorded: not recorded. This workspace has no context-use rollup yet.

related.title: Related records
related.unclassified: This record carries no kind, so Oxagen has nothing to compare it with.
related.only: None. This is the only {kind} in {workspace}.

meters.label: Effect over the runs Oxagen indexed
meters.rollupNotRecorded: Effect is not recorded. This workspace has no context-use rollup yet, so Oxagen shows no count rather than a zero that would read as every run ignoring the record.
meters.thirdNotRecorded: The third count is not recorded yet. No store counts the runs that went against a record.

deliver.rule: Compiled into the steering block of the policy bundle. must and should sit in the stable prefix every turn; may and info are selected by relevance.
deliver.constraint: Compiled into the stable prefix at whatever force it carries, and asserted by the checks against every other published record on the same subject.
deliver.procedure: Compiled like a rule, and rendered as an ordered list so a model cannot silently reorder it.
deliver.fact: Delivered as a fact context frame with provenance to this record and its commit, valid_from set to the merge time.
deliver.memory: Delivered as a memory context frame, selected by relevance, never pinned into the prefix.
deliver.preference: Delivered at may or info, selected by relevance and dropped first when the window is tight.

neverDo.rule: It cannot grant authority, and it cannot make a denied call allowed.
neverDo.constraint: It can narrow what is allowed. It can never widen it: a require does not create the permission it requires.
neverDo.procedure: A step is not an authority. Naming a governed action in a step does not put it on a belt.
neverDo.fact: It steers nothing by itself. A fact that needs to change behaviour is a rule that cites it.
neverDo.memory: It never forbids anything, and it is never evidence on its own. It is why a retry is not a regression, not proof that it was not.
neverDo.preference: It never blocks a call, and a run that ignored it is not a failing run.

unclassified.title: Kind
unclassified.body: The file records no kind, so Oxagen cannot say how this record is selected or what it does. Republish it through a pull request that states its kind, force and scope.

rule.forceUnknown: not recorded. The file states no force.

placement.prefix: the stable prefix, every turn in scope

rule.bundleNotRecorded: not recorded. The record's share of the compiled bundle is not read on this page yet.
rule.bundleVersion: v{version} · this record's tokens are not recorded yet

boundary.require: A run that has not done this cannot proceed past the point that needs it. The check is on the run, not on the call.
boundary.forbidNoGrant: This record carries no enforcement grant, so it compiles to text. The agent reads the boundary in its stable prefix. Nothing refuses a call because of it until a grant compiles a gate.
boundary.unknown: This workspace holds no require or forbid effect for this record, so it compiles to text and nothing refuses a call because of it.

constraint.conflicts: Every merge re-runs the conflict check across all {count} published records. A forbid that contradicts an active require on the same subject fails the check, so the two can never both be in force.
constraint.conflictsNoCount: Every merge re-runs the conflict check across every published record. A forbid that contradicts an active require on the same subject fails the check, so the two can never both be in force.

procedure.order: The order is the record. A run that did these in a different order did not follow this procedure, even if every step happened.

fact.falsifiableNotRecorded: not recorded. The file names no check that would falsify it.
fact.lastConfirmedValue: {runs} runs read it. Contradictions are not recorded yet.
fact.note: A fact that needs to change behaviour is a rule that cites it. Keeping the two apart is what lets a fact go stale without silently turning off a rule.

memory.explainsNotRecorded: not recorded. The file carries the statement and no separate explanation.
memory.selectionShare: by relevance, never pinned: {cited} of {rendered} runs that carried it actually used it
memory.decayValue: none automatic. A memory that stops being true is archived by a pull request, like everything else.

preference.soft: Nothing here blocks a call. "Violated" on a preference reads as not followed, and a run that did not follow it is not a failing run, which is why the counter below is grey and not red.

failure.orgRoleRequired: Your role cannot propose a change to this record. An org Owner or Admin, or a workspace Owner or Member, can.
failure.noPrincipal: Oxagen could not tell who is signed in. Sign in again and retry.
failure.recordNotFound: This workspace holds no record on that lineage.
failure.recordUnclassified: This record states no kind, force or scope, so Oxagen cannot write a valid file for it. Republish it through a pull request that states all three.
failure.constraintEffectUnknown: This constraint records no require or forbid effect. Change it through a new proposal, which states the effect.
failure.lineagePrOpen: A change is already open on this record. Merge or close that pull request first.
failure.repositoryMissing: This workspace has no repository bound, so Oxagen has nowhere to open a pull request.
failure.governanceUnreadable: Oxagen could not read governance.toml on the production branch.
failure.githubRefused: GitHub refused the write. Check that the Oxagen app still has write access to the repository.
failure.gitlabRefused: GitLab refused the write. Nothing was published. Check that the project access token still has the api scope and the Developer role, then try again.
failure.gitlabCredentialRejected: GitLab no longer accepts the project access token stored for this project. Nothing was changed. Connect the project again with a new token.
failure.invalid: Oxagen refused the statement. Check that it is not empty and retry.
failure.pendingApproval: Your change is waiting for approval. The request is {accessRequestId}.
failure.unavailable: Oxagen could not open the pull request: {code}. Retry, and report the code if it repeats.
failure.sectionPending: {section} is waiting for approval. The request is {accessRequestId}.

denied.title: You cannot see this record
denied.body: Your roles on {org} do not include {needed}. An organization owner can grant it; the grant is a governed action and lands in the audit record with your name on it.
denied.requestNotRecorded: Requesting access from this page is not recorded yet. Ask an organization owner for {needed}.
denied.decidedBy: the organization's policy · deny wins over every allow

pending.title: This record is waiting for approval
pending.body: Your read parked for approval. The request is {request}.

error.title: This record could not be loaded
error.body: The control plane answered <mono>{status} {code}</mono>. Nothing was changed. Runs kept recording while this page was down. Frames are written by the collector on each host, not by Oxagen.
error.incidentNotRecorded: Opening an incident from this page is not recorded yet. Report the code and the time below.
